name: screenshot-retry-binding
goal: Retain and select screenshot evidence by its executed case attempt.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Case outcomes include retry numbers but screenshot bindings omit them, so repeated attempts are ambiguous and a capture can be attributed to the wrong outcome.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing review cases cover shared cases and duplicates but only one attempt. Extend those same cases with bound retries, missing attempt bindings and duplicate attempts.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The bound retry was rejected as ambiguous and the unbound first capture was incorrectly labeled as a later passing attempt.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Require retry bindings for repeated attempts, select the latest executed capture, reject ambiguous or unexecuted attempts, and preserve optional retry metadata on reviews.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged two review cases passed at ff24e7bf72; the paired test-only record failed in the same environment.

steps.title: Reintroduce and restore retry misattribution in the existing review cases.
steps.evidence: Mutant 1e4baae344 failed capture 34e691f5546b; restored 817d3d72ad passed d2552b31bdd5 with the same tree as 0ff2c07f3f.

steps.title: Measure changed units and retain their representative workloads.
steps.evidence: At 7cae68c838, source bytes/lines/complexity/dependencies are 19708/520/128/11 for the baseline service and 18519/146/9/3 for guidance. Capture e4f505deb90b retains normal and retried workloads and whole-worker RSS; modules emit no separate artifacts.

steps.title: Recheck the final measured case against the original selector.
steps.evidence: Mutant 631a0bc0ed failed capture 72707949c83d; restored 4d7437e59d passed 492a32371a5e with the same tree as 7cae68c838.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
